2. make typecheck -> PASS. 'mypy src/rebar' => 'Success: no issues found in 383 source files'.

FULL gating suite (the exact CI command, 'pytest -m "not integration and not external" -q', NOT just tests/unit) -> PASS: 7517 passed, 29 skipped, 114 deselected, 17 warnings in 1783.41s (0:29:43), process exit code 0. Captured output: /Users/joeoakhart/.claude/jobs/4ca991d2/tmp/preflight_s4b.txt. Test count rose 7505 -> 7517 = the 12 new tests in tests/unit/test_openai_compatible_provider.py.
4. Story-specific oracle: tests/unit/test_openai_compatible_provider.py => 12 passed.
5. Import-contract check: 'import rebar.llm' pulls in NO heavy modules (httpx/anthropic/pydantic_ai/openai/boto3/botocore) — verified empirically, empty set.
6. Module-size: providers.py 289 LOC (under the 300 attested in closed story 7468); runner.py 800 LOC (the gate compares '$1 > lim', so 800 passes) — zero headroom is tracked separately as task 2682.

INDEPENDENT CONFIRMATION (the authoritative signal, not my local run): Gerrit change 1023 https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/1023 carries **Verified +1** — CI ran build/test/lint/typecheck on GitHub Actions against this exact commit and agreed — and **LLM-Review +1** from the review bot. Both votes were earned on the current patchset.

PROCESS NOTE for the remaining stories in epic 061c: I authored this criterion as untagged, which makes it codebase-verifiable by default, but its evidence is inherently external. Criteria of this shape should either be tagged [operator-attested] or phrased to point at recorded evidence (a change id plus a vote outcome). I will phrase the equivalent criterion that way on 2932/343b/8625 rather than repeat this round-trip.
